heading: Alien residents of Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, or the Northern Mariana Islands

tree.heading: General rule
tree.text: This subpart shall not apply to any alien individual who is a bona fide resident of Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, or the Northern Mariana Islands during the entire taxable year and such alien shall be subject to the tax imposed by section 1.
